sentiment.rationale: Guidance was raised materially: full-year constant-currency net sales guidance increased from 3.75%-4.75% to 4.8%-5.1%, and adjusted operating income guidance increased from unchanged to 4.8%-5.5%. The raise is organic, driven by strong operational momentum across segments, eCommerce growth of 27%, and market share gains. Management language is confident, with no meaningful risks raised that would offset the positive forward signal.

summary.eps: GAAP EPS of $0.77; Adjusted EPS of $0.62, up 6.9%.
summary.guidance: Full-year constant-currency net sales growth raised to 4.8%-5.1% (from 3.75%-4.75%). Full-year constant-currency adjusted operating income growth raised to 4.8%-5.5% (from unchanged). Adjusted EPS expected to be $2.58-$2.63.
summary.margin: Consolidated gross profit rate was 24.2%, up 2 bps. Adjusted operating income grew 8.0% in constant currency, faster than sales growth of 5.9%.
key_risks: Lower-income households under additional pressure, with some moderation in spending.
Merchandise category mix headwind to gross margin, as grocery and health & wellness outpace general merchandise.
Maximum fair pricing legislation effective January 2026 will affect health & wellness/pharmacy business comp.
Approximately 150 bps of headwinds from VIZIO acquisition and lapping leap year.
key_opportunities: eCommerce growth of 27% globally, with each segment above 20%.
Global advertising business grew 53% (including VIZIO); Walmart Connect US up 33%.
Membership income grew 17% globally; Walmart+ net adds strongest on record.
Supply chain automation: >50% of eCommerce fulfillment center volume automated, driving lower shipping costs.
AI and technology driving efficiency; partnership with OpenAI for ChatGPT checkout.
Market share gains across grocery, general merchandise, and higher-income households.
International segment strong, led by Flipkart, China, and Walmex.

management_tone.label: confident
management_tone.justification: Management uses phrases like 'strong quarter,' 'well positioned to finish the year with momentum,' and 'we're playing offense,' and raised guidance, reflecting clear confidence in the forward outlook.
